2609.16937.title: Beyond Token-Local Imitation: Reward-Compatible Temporal Credit Assignment for On-Policy Distillation
2609.16937.paper_summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective approach for large language model post-training, yet existing objectives face a trade-off between objective fidelity and optimization stability. Token-level OPD provides stable but local supervision, whereas sequence-level OPD captures future credit at the cost of horizon-dependent variance. We establish a unified temporal-credit view of these formulations, showing that practical token-level OPD can be interpreted as a temporal approximation to the sequence-level reverse-KL gradient. Building on this connection, we propose $γ$OPD, which uses discounted temporal credit assignment to balance long-horizon supervision and optimization stability, while admitting a horizon-independent variance bound. We further develop a reward-compatible bounded mixing (RBM) mechanism for $γ\mathrm{OPD}$ that balances verifiable outcome feedback with the discounted OPD advantage to move beyond purely teacher-dependent optimization. Experiments on mathematical and code reasoning demonstrate consistent improvements over existing OPD methods across vanilla, size-mismatched, and multi-teacher distillation settings.
2609.16937.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾（OPD）中，已經成為大型語言模型後訓練的一種有效方法，但現有的目標面臨著目標忠實度和優化穩定性之間的權衡。<lb/> 令牌級的 OPD 提供穩定但局部的監督，而序列級的 OPD 以時間依賴的方差為代價捕捉未來的信貸。<lb/> 我們建立了這些公式的統一時間信貸觀，表明實際的令牌級 OPD 可以被解釋為序列級反 KL 梯度的時間近似。<lb/> 基於這一聯繫，我們提出了 $γ$OPD，該方法使用折扣時間信貸分配來平衡長期監督和優化穩定性，同時允許獨立於時間的方差界限。<lb/> 我們進一步為 $γ\mathrm{OPD}$ 開發了一種獎勵兼容的有界混合（RBM）機制，該機制平衡可驗證的結果反饋與折扣 OPD 優勢，以超越純粹依賴教師的優化。<lb/> 在數學和代碼推理上的實驗顯示，在普通、大小不匹配和多教師蒸餾設置中，與現有的 OPD 方法相比，均有一致的改進。
